create_TrainingStats: create a TrainingStats instance to track vital training statistics for a detectron model
update_UpdateIterStats: update tracked iteration statistics by summing losses and averaging metrics across GPUs
log_LogIterStats: log tracked training statistics as JSON at periodic intervals during SGD iterations
get_GetStats: get a dictionary of current training stats including loss, ETA, learning rate, and GPU memory
timer_IterTic_IterToc: start and stop the iteration timer using IterTic and IterToc to measure iteration elapsed time
